description: This file implements a Compass view for an Android application, utilizing device sensors to display an orientation indicator with a custom drawing method.

classes.name: Compass
classes.description: Main Activity class that manages sensor updates and contains the custom view.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Inner class extending View to handle custom drawing of the compass.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the sensor manager, sensor, and custom view; sets the content view.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers the sensor listener when activity resumes.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Unregisters the sensor listener when activity stops.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles drawing the compass arrow based on sensor data.

methods.name: onAttachedToWindow
methods.description: Starts animation when view is attached.

methods.name: onDetachedFromWindow
methods.description: Stops animation when view is detached.
